description_en: Queries the list of projects that are not associated with a project authorization
description_zh: 查询未关联到项目授权的项目列表
name: ListProjectsNotForProjectAuthorization

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the bastion host instance.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/153281.html operation to obtain the bastion host instance ID
parameters.help_zh:
堡垒机的实例ID。

可通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/153281.html接口获取堡垒机实例ID
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the bastion host.
For the mapping between region IDs and region names, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/40654.html
parameters.help_zh:
堡垒机的地域ID。
地域ID和地域名称的对应关系，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/40654.html
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The paging token. Leave this parameter empty or do not specify this parameter for the first request
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询开始的Token。首次请求不传或者传空字符串
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of projects to return per request. Valid values: 1 to 100. Default value: 20
parameters.help_zh: 单次请求获取最大项目个数，取值 1-100 整数。不传时默认取值 20
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en:
The project authorization ID.
You can call the ListProjectAuthorizations operation to obtain this parameter
parameters.help_zh:
项目授权ID。
您可以调用ListProjectAuthorizations接口获取该参数
parameters.name: authorization_id

parameters.help_en: The project name to query. Fuzzy match is supported
parameters.help_zh: 要查询的项目名称。模糊查询
parameters.name: keyword

parameters.help_en:
The number of entries to skip.

This parameter takes effect only when NextToken is empty
parameters.help_zh:
跳过数量。

仅在 NextToken 取值为空时生效
parameters.name: skip
